paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Wednesday, batted ninth and appeared at third base for Minnesota Twins against New York Yankees. Minnesota Twins beat New York Yankees, 5-4.
Brooks Lee went 1-for-2, 1 run scored, 1 walk.
Away from the box scores, there was also roster movement involving former Mustangs.
Drew Thorpe was activated in a roster move.
title: Brooks Lee scores as Minnesota Twins picks up a win
